name: Accommodation and food service

bnote.551001: NIC splits hotels into two codes with the same activity. Because no company can repeat, ten listed hotel companies are divided between 551001 and 551099.
bnote.551099: The same hotel economics as 551001. Kamat Hotels and Oriental Hotels are also listed but not used here to avoid a near-duplicate business mix.
bnote.554001: Only three listed. OYO's parent (PRISM) has filed IPO papers but is not listed. MakeMyTrip trades on Nasdaq, not on an Indian exchange.
bnote.554002: Mahindra Holidays is the only listed time-share operator found.
bnote.561001: All five are quick-service franchisees or operators of global brands (Domino's, KFC, Pizza Hut, McDonald's, Burger King, Taco Bell).
bnote.561099: Full-service dining. Only two listed names found.
bnote.562901: Travel Food Services runs food and beverage concessions at travel hubs.
bnote.563002: Coffee Day Enterprises owns the Café Coffee Day chain. It is the only listed coffee-house operator found.
bnote.564000: Both are food-delivery platforms. Their large losses and one-off items make margin comparison difficult.

flags.chalet: Revenue jumped 61% in FY26; net profit was ₹1.4 bn in FY25 and ₹6.5 bn in FY26.
flags.leela: Net margin rose from 3.6% to 26.4% in one year. The cause was not checked here.
flags.samhi: FY26 net profit includes an income-tax benefit of about ₹3.0 bn, so net margin, ROE and P/E are not operating results.
flags.tcook: Revenue is gross travel and forex billing, so low margins are structural for this model.
flags.jubl: Restaurant EBITDA depends on how lease costs are treated. Compare restaurant chains only with that in mind.
flags.ufbl: Renamed from Barbeque-Nation Hospitality in September 2025.
flags.ccd: FY26 net profit comes mainly from unusual items (₹2.6 bn) and a tax credit. Its 2.2x P/E means nothing.
flags.eternal: Revenue grew 169%, which points to a change in how quick-commerce sales are booked. The cause was not checked here.

notes: Kamat Hotels and Oriental Hotels are also India-listed hotel operators but are not placed in any business code here, to keep every company used at most once across the whole document.
